basic_details.job_title: NHSRC Consultant, Tele MANAS – KMD Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Knowledge Management Division (KMD) of the National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC), New Delhi, is seeking a Consultant for Tele MANAS on behalf of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare. The post is purely on a contractual basis, with remuneration of Rs. 60,000-1,20,000/- per month. Applicants need MBBS/BDS/Psychology with Masters/post-graduate diploma in Public Health/Health Management and minimum 3 years of experience in Public Health, and must be 40 years and below as of the last date of application. Applications are accepted online on the NHSRC website until 08 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: About NHSRC
content_sections.text: The National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) is based in New Delhi. In this notice it invites applications on behalf of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare. The post sits in its Knowledge Management Division and supports the implementation of Tele MANAS.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Minimum 3 years of experience in Public Health. Experience in one or all of the following: qualitative research, quantitative research, documentation, data analysis. At least 2 years of post qualification experience. Excellent analytical skills, communication and presentation skills, and interpersonal abilities. Excellent oral and written communication skills in English. Those with Diploma/Certificate Course/Work experience in Mental Health will be given preference. Desirable: experience in direct implementation of health service delivery programs through Government, NGOs, or Regional Resource Centers. Desirable: published work in the area of health systems or public health. The age limit is 40 years & below, counted as of the last date of application. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: MBBS/BDS/ Psychology with Masters/ post-graduate diploma in Public Health / Health Management.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Consultant is engaged purely on a contractual basis. The remuneration is Rs. 60,000-1,20,000/- (Rupees sixty thousand to one lakh twenty thousand per month). The notice does not state the contract period or how the amount within this range is decided. The Reporting Officer is the Advisor, Knowledge Management Division (KMD), NHSRC.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Provide Technical Assistance in areas related to Tele MANAS implementation. Conduct regular field visits for monitoring and supportive supervision for Tele MANAS implementation. Develop study/ evaluation protocols, undertake and guide studies/ operational research and impact assessments for improving design of Tele MANAS. Maintain database of all relevant documents and data related to allocated work area. Support the Senior and Lead consultants in any other allotted task. Provide technical inputs to research studies/protocols as and when required. Support review and analysis of published and grey literature and data available through various sources on a periodic basis, including National / State / District level survey, HMIS, Sustainable Development Goal indicators and Universal Health Coverage indicators. Support in creating platform for partners/stakeholders to share and create evidence-based knowledge, enabling the uptake of information to strengthen Tele MANAS. Ensure availability of information from available data sources in an easily transferrable and usable form, based on the requirement of the Knowledge Management and other divisions. Identify best practices and innovations within states and districts and support in documentation. Undertake review of literature and stay up-to-date on current trends in Tele MANAS. Ensure timely and high-quality responses to MoHFW and Parliament Questions pertaining to the division. Support Knowledge Management Division on all administrative and technical matters. Support Advisor in other assignments as and when required.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHSRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the NHSRC website, http://nhsrcindia.org , where the online application is available. Fill in the online application correctly. Use the prescribed online application format only, as applications in any other format will not be accepted. Make sure the application is received by 08 December 2026, the last date for receiving applications. The notice does not name any documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice does not describe the selection stages. It states one condition: if the recruitment process includes a written test, the minimum qualifying mark will be 70%.
